WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand,
           COUNT(*) AS fielding_count
    FROM fielding AS f
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '')
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(fielding_count) AS total_count,
           AVG(fielding_count) AS avg_count
    FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT hc.batting_hand,
       hc.fielding_count,
       1.0 * hc.fielding_count / t.total_count AS share_of_total,
       hc.fielding_count - t.avg_count AS above_average
FROM hand_counts AS hc
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE hc.fielding_count > t.avg_count;
